1. What does Jo want to try?
Boy: Do you want to paint?
Girl: I enjoy painting already. I want to try chess.

2. What should Sam bring?
Girl: Bring an old magazine for our kite.
Boy: All right. I needn’t bring my camera.

3. Where will they make kites?
Boy: Can we fly kites today?
Girl: It is wet, so we will work indoors.

4. Which club meets at lunchtime?
Girl: Does painting meet at lunchtime?
Boy: No, the board game group does.

5. What did Eva finish?
Boy: Did you finish the album?
Girl: Not yet. I finished my painting first.
